tpl: Performs 8 notes; the Arts damage dealt by each note starts at {0} of ATK but gradually reduces to {1}; Can store 2 charges; releases 1 charge automatically when charges are full

Swap between performing on the piano (starting) and organ timbres. Piano: ATK +{0}, notes fly faster; notes pierce enemies, dealing Physical damage Organ: ASPD +{1}, notes deal Arts damage and fly slower During Fever, the current timbre deals double strikes

Attack Range expands, performs on both piano and organ timbres at once, each timbre creating 2 notes that deal {0} of ATK as Physical and Arts damage respectively, which home in on the enemy with the highest RES or DEF respectively During Fever, Ave Mujica members who receive fatal damage will not retreat until Fever is over
